content: The file was not uploaded because the names in the destination folder could not be checked. Try again.

comment.text: Error shown on a file in the upload panel (and as the upload error of an embedded page) when an upload into a private, end-to-end encrypted room is stopped because the list of files already in the destination folder could not be read, so the client could not check for a file of the same name. Try again is an imperative addressed to the user.
